name: Jose Camacho-Collados

affiliations.role: Professor, Cardiff University; co-founder of Cardiff NLP

bio: José Camacho-Collados is a professor at the School of Computer Science and Informatics at Cardiff University and a UKRI Future Leaders Fellow, and co-founded the Cardiff NLP group in 2020. Their work covers lexical semantics, language models and social media NLP, including the TweetEval benchmark and the WiC dataset.
